Wall.HeightHint: Levels are assigned automatically from this elevation range.

PeekingMode.Name: Automatic peeking
PeekingMode.Hint: Allow tokens adjacent to sight-blocking cover to use target-specific peeking positions. Outside combat, eligible tokens may peek; during combat, only the active combatant may peek.

VisibilitySampleMode.Name: Target area
VisibilitySampleMode.Hint: Choose how much of the target is tested when deciding visibility and cover.

VisionSourceMode.Name: Viewing position
VisionSourceMode.Hint: Choose whether a token looks from its center or from several points within its occupied space.

NewWallHeightMode.Name: New wall height
NewWallHeightMode.Hint: Keep Foundry's viewed-Level assignment for newly drawn walls and also match their WAVES bottom/top heights, or make them apply unbounded across all Levels. Use the Toggle new wall height mode keybinding (Alt+W by default) to switch modes before drawing a wall.

VisibilityCalculationMode.Name: Visibility mode
VisibilityCalculationMode.Hint: Use Foundry's center-based visibility with height-aware walls, or WAVES sampled visibility and cover.

EyeHeightPercent.Name: Eye height
EyeHeightPercent.Hint: Default eye position as a percentage of the token's vertical depth.

EyeTolerancePercent.Name: Vertical eye movement
EyeTolerancePercent.Hint: How far a token can normally look above or below its eye height, as a percentage of its vertical depth.

EyeSampleCount.Name: Vertical eye positions
EyeSampleCount.Hint: Number of eye positions tested across the allowed vertical movement.

ShowPassableWallOverlay.Name: Show height-passable walls
ShowPassableWallOverlay.Hint: Draw green dashed overlays for walls that do not overlap the controlled token's current vertical volume.

SynchronizeTokenLevel.Name: Synchronize token Level with elevation
SynchronizeTokenLevel.Hint: Prompt to move tokens to a matching Level when their elevation crosses a Level boundary. WAVES disables this handling when Elevation Level Change module is active.

PerformanceDebug.Name: Performance debug
PerformanceDebug.Hint: Log aggregated WAVES timing data to the console.

LevelTransition.Title: WAVES: Change Token Level
LevelTransition.CompatibilityWarning: WAVES: Elevation Level Change module is active, so WAVES token Level synchronization is disabled. Elevation Level Change may permit token elevation and Level to become mismatched.

ToggleNewWallHeightMode.Name: Toggle new wall height mode
ToggleNewWallHeightMode.Hint: Switch the new-wall placement mode between Viewed Level and All Levels (Unbounded).

NewWallHeightMode.Level: WAVES: New wall height — Viewed Level (Foundry default)
NewWallHeightMode.Unbounded: WAVES: New wall height — All Levels (Unbounded)
